exposure: nuchal cord (single, double, and multiple loops)
cohort: 303 single gestation term pregnancies with spontaneous labor.
finding: Nuchal cord was not associated with neonatal death or a bad Apgar score (<7) at 1 and 5 minutes, but multiple nuchal cords were associated with meconium-stained liquor, neonatal admission in intensive care, fetal distress, and emergency C-section.
